chapter: Joe Oliver and the second line
title: Joe Oliver as teacher
summary: Armstrong says Oliver took time to show young musicians passages while others were too busy at the Eagle Saloon.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: I wouldn't listen to it. I've noticed you've talked a lot about Joe Oliver, and he must have been a tremendous influence.

I love Joe because he's taking more time with the other musicians. I noticed they all were so busy going to the Eagle Saloon. And I feel a boy, he might say, well, would you show me how this passage goes, you know, you're a little stuck with this division. Oh boy, I ain't got time to be bothered with that. But Joe would stop. Listen here. Listen to where that goes. Don't forget that.
